title: [CQ-M07v2] Docs: verified-local tool contracts and troubleshooting codes (MCP_SERVER, TROUBLESHOOTING)
definitionOfDone: MCP_SERVER.md has sections for moe.get_execution_readiness (with GET_EXECUTION_READINESS) and moe.get_seat_liveness. Their payload fields match tools/getExecutionReadiness.ts and the liveness tool's source, field for field.
MCP_SERVER.md no longer shows verifiedLocal false for serverCapabilities. The six strict-consumer sentences state the retained-verified-delivery rule, and both comment-c16cb64b points are applied.

TROUBLESHOOTING.md has one row for each MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_*, MOE_SEAT_* and MOE_VM_* code that scripts/moe-agent.sh or moe-agent.ps1 prints, and for each READINESS_IDS id with its operator action. The completion summary shows the grep that proves none is missing.
`npm run lint` passes, and the daemon suite passes in a git-archive snapshot with the docs overlaid.

comments.content:
Planner note from architect-c33f294e, who is planning CQ-M07v1 (task-63e6fb62), 2026-11-04. CQ-M07v1 now DEPENDS ON this row, so the two no longer run in parallel. Three things this row's plan should carry:

1. MCP_SERVER.md:3375. v1's DoD 1 greps all of docs/ for 'unconditionally unavailable'. At planning, the only match outside v1's own files is docs/MCP_SERVER.md:3375, in the 'Capabilities describe wire support…' paragraph next to the serverCapabilities section that your DoD 2 covers: "…verified-local stays unconditionally unavailable…". Rewrite that sentence from the landed code: client capabilities never grant verified-local; it is refused until the daemon's readiness evaluation passes. Prove it with `git grep -n 'unconditionally unavailable' -- docs/MCP_SERVER.md` printing nothing, and also scan the joined lines (`tr '\n' ' ' | tr -s ' '`), because the doc wraps. If this phrase survives, v1's worker report_blocks on this row.

2. Root CLAUDE.md has two stale mentions that no M07 docs row owns yet:
   - the lifecycle paragraph says "(a profile not yet available)";
   - the "Working in this repo" settings bullet says "`executionProfile` (`verified-local` stays refused; the decision is in `docs/baselines/cq-m06/README.md`)".
   Take both as a third file here, or name an owner in your plan. Keep the README pointer: the final row records the promotion decision there.

3. Derived token check. One of v1's checkRefs takes every MOE_ token that CQ-M07r/s/t add to the wrappers and requires each one to appear in docs/CONFIGURATION.md or docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md. Your DoD 3 covers the MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_*/MOE_SEAT_*/MOE_VM_* codes; v1 covers the env overrides and the worktree-family codes. A probe on the landed M07m3/n3 rows shows today's TROUBLESHOOTING gaps:
